ScriptLines.ScriptLine: // EACH TARGET TYPE'S RULE OPTIONS, IN ORDER. THE NAMES ARE THE LABELS SHOWN ON THE TARGET TAB, UNDER THE LINE THAT SHOWS WHICH
// CREDENTIAL THE RULE USES. THEIR POSITIONS MUST MATCH WHAT SendRule IN THE RULES EXTENSION CLASS READS.
// AN OPTION IS FREE TEXT UNLESS IT IS GIVEN A LIST OF CHOICES HERE. TO GIVE ONE A LIST, PASS THE CHOICES AFTER ITS NAME. EACH
// CHOICE IS THE VALUE THAT IS STORED, AND A DESCRIPTION SHOWN BESIDE IT IN THE LIST:
// Option("DeleteBehavior", Choice("Skip", "Skip deletes."), Choice("Delete", "Send deletes through."))
// EACH OPTION HAS TWO INPUTS BOUND TO THE SAME PROPERTY: OptionNNEdit, A TEXT BOX, AND OptionNNCombo, A COMBOBOX. A SCRIPT
// CAN'T CHANGE A COMPONENT'S TYPE, SO THE SCRIPT SHOWS THE COMBOBOX WHEN THE OPTION HAS CHOICES AND THE TEXT BOX WHEN IT DOESN'T.
// THE COMBOBOX'S LIST SOURCE IS INLINE ENTRIES(V(OptionNNChoices)) DISPLAY(1,2) VALUE(1) SO ITS LIST COMES FROM THE FORM
// VARIABLE OptionNNChoices, WHICH THIS SCRIPT SETS TO THE OPTION'S CHOICES FOR THE RULE'S TARGET TYPE.
// THE CREDENTIAL'S VALUES AREN'T SHOWN ON THIS FORM. THEY ARE ENTERED, LABELLED AND MASKED ON THE CREDENTIALS FORM.
Dictionary<string, List<KeyValuePair<string, string[]>>> config = new Dictionary<string, List<KeyValuePair<string, string[]>>>()
Choice("Skip", "Skip deletes and don't send them to Salesforce."),
Choice("Delete", "Send all deletes through to Salesforce.")
List<KeyValuePair<string, string[]>> options = config.ContainsKey(ruleTargetType) ? config[ruleTargetType] : new List<KeyValuePair<string, string[]>>();
string[] choices = isUsed ? options[counter].Value : new string[0];
// HAND THE CHOICES TO THE COMBOBOX THROUGH ITS FORM VARIABLE. WHEN THEY CHANGE, FOR EXAMPLE ON MOVING TO A RULE WITH ANOTHER
// TARGET TYPE, THE COMBOBOX IS TOLD TO LOAD ITS LIST AGAIN.
// THE LIST IS STILL LOADED FROM THE VARIABLE THE NEXT TIME THE COMBOBOX READS ITS LIST SOURCE
// AN OPTION'S NAME, AND ITS CHOICES IF IT HAS ANY. NO CHOICES MEANS FREE TEXT.
private static KeyValuePair<string, string[]> Option(string name, params string[] choices)
// ONE CHOICE, AS AN INLINE LIST ENTRY: THE VALUE AND THE DESCRIPTION, SEPARATED BY A BACKSLASH. ENTRIES ARE SEPARATED BY COMMAS
// INSIDE ENTRIES( ), SO NEITHER PART MAY CONTAIN A COMMA, A BACKSLASH OR A PARENTHESIS.
private static string Choice(string value, string description)
